The *Rūpadhātukathā* is the fifth debate in the eighth chapter (vagga) of the *Kathāvatthu*, situated in the Abhidhamma Piṭaka of the Pali Canon [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records one translation of the text in modern languages [SuttaCentral].
